relevance_note: Single case report of an 11-month-old boy with a histopathological diagnosis of Alexander disease ("leading to a diagnosis of Alexander disease"); no GFAP variant or genetic testing is mentioned.
method_note: Hand-extracted from the full text (no table transcription). The paper is a single case report (publication year not printed in the Markdown, so year is null) diagnosed by stereotaxic brain biopsy; it names no gene, no variant and no genetic testing, so the variants table is empty (the paper ties no GFAP variant to the patient) and n_patients_reported (defined as patients with a GFAP variant) is null. The person is in scope through the diagnosis of Alexander disease. Parts of the converted text are garbled OCR (e.g. the abstract and the infantile-group description in the Discussion); nothing was taken from garbled passages. Imaging findings were recorded as phenotypic features with the modality in brackets. 'The left side was completely normal' was not turned into specific excluded features. 'normal ... developmental milestones' recorded as developmental delay excluded under D-27. CT 'no mass effect, shift, edema' was not used to exclude hydrocephalus or raised intracranial pressure. The CT/MR caudate-head abnormality was counted as observed for the basal ganglia checklist item and the MR white matter hypointensity for cerebral white matter abnormality. Age at diagnosis is not stated separately; 11 months is recorded as age at last evaluation (age at presentation). Vital status not stated. No contradictions found.
